import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem shifted_quadratic_range_isLeast
  (t : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (hf : f = fun x ↦ (x - t) ^ 2 + (t + 1)) :
  IsLeast (Set.range f) (t + 1) := by
  have h₁ : t + 1 ∈ Set.range f := by
    rw [Set.mem_range]
    
    use t
    
    rw [hf]
    <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf <;> norm_num
    <;>
    linarith
  
  have h₂ : ∀ y ∈ Set.range f, t + 1 ≤ y := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [hf]
    
    have h₃ : (x - t) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  
  have h₃ : IsLeast (Set.range f) (t + 1) := by
    refine' ⟨h₁, _⟩
    intro y hy
    exact h₂ y hy
  
  exact h₃

      <;> simp [sq]
      <;> ring_nf

      have h₄ : f x = (x - t) ^ 2 + (t + 1) := by
        rw [hf]
        <;> simp [sq]
      rw [h₄]

        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - t)]
      nlinarith
